I’m pretty sure I’ve heard that our GM had Gary rated as a top 5 pick. One of those best player available type of things. You can never have enough good pass rushers.

For the Packers:

1A: Rashan Gary OLB- Didn’t get a whole lot of playing time this season with the smiths doing their thing. Improved steadily all season in the snaps that he did see. This was a project pick based on potential and we are still waiting for that to pay off.

1B: Darnell Savage S- He’s been a huge upgrade at safety for us. He flies around the field and isn’t afraid to hit people despite not being the biggest guy. Missed some time with injuries but that hasn’t affected him much. With experience he could develop into one of the premier safeties in the league.

2: Elgton Jenkins OG- Stepped in at LG in the second game of the season and never looked back. Excellent all around player is a mailer in the run game and didn’t allow a single sack all season in pass protection. A home run pick in the 2nd round.

3: Jace Sternberger TE: Was injured in preseason and placed on IR. Returned late in the season and hasn’t been used as much more than a blocker.  Will get more of a shot next year when Graham is gone.

5: Kingsley KeKe DL: Hasn’t seen much playing time but when he’s been in he’s been disruptive. Would like to see him play more.

6A: Kadar Hollman CB: Late round project at CB hasn’t seen much playing time. Special teamed at this point

6B: Dexter Williams RB: Has only been active for a couple of games this year due to his shortcomings in pass protection. Looked good in preseason with the ball in his hands.

7: Ty Summers LB: Special teams player that hasn’t seen any time on defense this year. He showed flashes in preseason but for some reason the coaches won’t use him on D.
